search.query: | mstats latest(_value) WHERE index=cisco_metrics metric_name="mdt_nx_cdp_info_devId" BY extracted_source interface_name devId | eval from=extracted_source, to=devId, local_if=interface_name | append [| mstats latest(_value) WHERE index=cisco_metrics metric_name="mdt_xe_cdp_info_device_name" BY extracted_source cdp_neighbor_detail_device_id device_name | join type=left extracted_source cdp_neighbor_detail_device_id [| mstats latest(_value) WHERE index=cisco_metrics metric_name="mdt_xe_cdp_info_local_intf_name" BY extracted_source cdp_neighbor_detail_device_id local_intf_name] | join type=left extracted_source cdp_neighbor_detail_device_id [| mstats latest(_value) WHERE index=cisco_metrics metric_name="mdt_xe_cdp_info_port_id" BY extracted_source cdp_neighbor_detail_device_id port_id] | eval from=extracted_source, to=device_name, local_if=local_intf_name, remote_if=port_id] | append [search index="cisco_events" event_group="cdp" | eval from=mvindex(node,0), to=mvindex(neighbour,0), local_if=mvindex(interface,0), remote_if=mvindex(remote_interface,0)] | where NOT match(local_if, "(?i)^(mgmt|e0m)") AND NOT match(coalesce(remote_if, ""), "(?i)^(mgmt|e0m)") | eval from=lower(replace(from, "[.(].*$$", "")), to=lower(replace(to, "[.(].*$$", "")) | where from!=to | eval node1=if(from<to, from, to), node2=if(from<to, to, from) | stats dc(eval(local_if)) as reported_links by node1 node2 from | stats max(reported_links) as links by node1 node2 | eval from=node1, to=node2, linkwidth=min(2*links, 10) | table from to linkwidth
